name: HPC Medx
old_description: We specialize in providing contract manufacturing services for medical devices. As an ISO 13485:2016 Certified and FDA Registered company, you can trust us to provide high quality, reliable, and compliant services to meet your individual needs.
about:
HPC Medx operates from Hanover, Pennsylvania, where it provides contract manufacturing services for the medical device industry. The company is led by CEO Dominic Sinibaldi, though its founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

Its service portfolio spans ultrasonic cleaning of medical parts, precision assembly and packaging, custom packaging design, warehousing and distribution, high‑precision machining from an in‑house machine shop that reduces tooling lead times, UDI‑compliant imprinting and labeling, and device testing and inspection. The firm emphasizes regulatory compliance, holding ISO 13485:2016 certification and FDA registration.

HPC Medx serves medical device manufacturers and developers, offering support from raw‑material evaluation through final packaging and distribution. Customers range from startups needing prototype runs to established firms requiring scalable production and logistics, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The company states its differentiator as delivering "clean, reliable, custom solutions that are delivered on time and to your specifications," highlighting on‑time delivery, regulatory adherence, and tailored process development.
